technique_name: Summarize the main points of the article about Cognitive Behavioral Therapy.
description: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is a type of psychotherapy that focuses on how a person’s thoughts, beliefs and attitudes influence their behavior. CBT is an umbrella term that encompasses a variety of approaches which all recognize that a person’s thoughts and beliefs can affect their behavior and their emotions. CBT is based on the idea that our thoughts create our feelings and our feelings create our behaviors. CBT is problem focused, meaning that the therapist and the client work together
